name: B10-0244/2026 – § 17 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text: 17. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to strengthen the enforcement of occupational safety and health legislation, including by ensuring adequate resources for labour inspectorates, improving cross-border cooperation and ensuring effective compliance, in particular in cases where gross negligence has led to serious injury or death; considers that in order for occupational safety and health rules to be credible and effective, they must be sufficiently dissuasive and proportionate; calls for the strengthening of enforcement mechanisms, and for the possibility of criminal liability – including corporate liability and, where applicable under national law, corporate manslaughter – in cases of serious and deliberate breaches of occupational safety obligations resulting in fatalities, in order to ensure full accountability;
